profile_text.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government-backed research institution that describes itself as recruiting globally for work in artificial intelligence, large language models, embodied AI, trustworthy AI, AI for Science, and foundational platforms. The laboratory operates collaborative doctoral programs with leading Chinese universities including Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tongji University, University of Science and Technology of China, and Zhejiang University, beginning in 2022.

The laboratory develops InternLM, a Chinese open-source large language model for academic research. Beyond language models, Shanghai AI Lab has announced the Shuusheng Duanyan scientific discovery platform, designed to support the full research cycle from hypothesis generation to experimental validation through scientific large models, professional AI agents, and embodied automation equipment. The laboratory also released Intern-Robotics, described as an end-to-end embodied AI stack engine. At the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference, the lab released ten joint scientific intelligence innovation results with partner institutions across life sciences, materials science, and deep space astronomy.

The laboratory frames AI safety and capability development as requiring balance along a 45-degree trajectory, and describes pursuing trustworthy AI through approaches centered on causality, progressing through stages of alignment, intervention, and reflection. It emphasizes comprehensive risk management across assessment, training, foundation, application, and validation phases.
